summary: Decompose god function build_parser in cli_work

delivery.outcome: Decompose god function build_parser in src/koru/cli_work.py: move the per-subcommand add_argument blocks into module-level spec tuples (_START_ARGS, _FINISH_ARGS, _NEXT_ARGS) applied through a single _add_subcommand helper, dropping build_parser from fan-out=11 / mutations=33 to fan-out=5 / mutations=5 and keeping _add_subcommand at fan-out=3 / mutations=4 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while preserving the identical CLI surface: flags, defaults, help strings, prog/description and set_defaults(func=...) dispatch consumed by work_main.
nonGoals: Adding, renaming or changing the behavior of any koru work CLI flag
Sharing the start/next --base/--no-push/--remote flags through a common spec (kept per-subcommand for byte-identical help output)

architecture.decision: Table-driven argparse construction: each subcommand's arguments are declared as module-level (flags, kwargs) tuples and one _add_subcommand(sub, name, help, args, func) helper performs the add_parser/add_argument/set_defaults calls. A plain per-subcommand helper split would keep 9-11 builder calls per function, still above the code2llm mutation threshold (>6) that counts every add_*/set_* builder call.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline add_argument blocks in build_parser.
